_comment: Tolerated one-sided supersessions, keyed superseder>superseded. A RATCHET on the same terms as .verify-lint-baseline.json: an entry needs a stated reason, and the set may only shrink. Remove an entry by writing the missing declaration on the side that lacks it.

BG0184>CR0331.reason: PRE-EXISTING at this kind's introduction (US0484). The supersession is recorded on one side only and the missing half is real DEBT, not judged-legitimate asymmetry: the superseding artefact never wrote down what it replaced, so a reader arriving at the superseded one from that direction still sees it as live. Recorded so the ratchet can be enforced from here; the SET MAY ONLY SHRINK, and removing an entry by writing the missing declaration is the only permitted direction.
BG0184>CR0331.note: CR0331 records being superseded by BG0184, but BG0184 does not say it supersedes CR0331
